what_happened: Sweep for scope item (4) found report/summary skeleton gaps well beyond the 4 formal agents and beyond the typst/lean candidates named in the dispatch: nix-implementation-agent.md and neovim-implementation-agent.md and web-implementation-agent.md (summary skeletons missing Impacts/Follow-ups/References), web-research-agent.md (report skeleton missing Context & Scope) -- all mechanically confirmed FAIL via validate-artifact.sh itself on the extracted skeleton. A larger, likely pre-existing systemic gap was also found in founder (8 agents: analyze, deck-builder, deck-research, finance, founder-implement, founder-spreadsheet, legal-council, market, strategy), present (budget-agent, slide-critic-agent, slides-research-agent), epidemiology (epi-research-agent, epi-implement-agent) -- these use heavily domain-customized report shapes (e.g. '## Summary' instead of '## Executive Summary', no Decisions/Recommendations at all) that still land under specs/*/reports or /summaries and are subject to the universal path-convention validate-artifact.sh sweep in skill-base.sh's skill_validate_task_artifacts. Recorded in the research report's enumeration per scope item (4); left unfixed and recommended as separate per-extension records, consistent with the hard constraint that this record declares file_scope for only the 4 formal agents.

Diagnosis was fully re-derived and mechanically confirmed rather than taken on faith: (1) built a fixture report shaped exactly like the real BimodalLogic failure (only '## Context Extension Recommendations', no Recommendations heading anywhere) and ran the real validate-artifact.sh on it -- failed with the exact reported error; (2) ran validate-artifact.sh on variants with top-level '## Recommendations' and with the formal agents' current nested '### Recommendations' shape -- both passed, confirming scope item (2)'s any-depth regex claim and that the current skeleton is not itself invalid; (3) extracted all four formal agents' literal embedded skeletons via a line-based fence parser and ran the real validator against each -- all four PASS as currently written, confirming the defect is purely a drift/burial risk, not a present structural failure.

Research report's five decisions were directly adoptable as phase boundaries with no re-derivation; two further plan-time measurements (none of the four formal agents list report-format.md in Context References, and formal is not a loaded extension in this repo so no deployed counterpart exists) closed latent holes in the single-referenceable-home remedy before implementation rather than during it.

Phase 1 sweep harness re-run found one additional FAIL beyond the research report's enumerated founder-extension gap list: agent-system/extensions/founder/agents/project-agent.md (report: missing Executive Summary, Context & Scope, Findings, Decisions). The report named 9 founder agents as failing while describing them as 'eight'; project-agent.md was not among the 9 named. The Phase 1 harness's captured baseline (fixtures/sweep-baseline.txt) is used as the authoritative measurement for Phase 5's follow-up enumeration rather than the report's stale list.

Phase 2's required-heading verification caught a real authoring defect in the new report-format.md prose before it shipped: 'Recommended Next Steps' initially wrapped across two source lines, so grep -c 'Recommended Next Steps' returned 0 against the plan's own verification criterion (expects >=1). Fixed by rewording to keep the phrase on one line. The plan's own verification step caught this immediately rather than letting it ship as a second, subtler near-miss drift.
git-commit-phase.sh dropped 'agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json' from a phase commit pathspec: not contained in this task's declared file_scope.

Phase 3's pointer conversion attests nothing else arose: general-research-agent.md already carried the report-format.md Context References entry, so no dead-link risk; the harness, verify-deploy gates 3/4, and the task-reference/record-versioning lints all passed cleanly on the first try.
